args.body:
label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

pickLocale splits the header by commas and takes the first matching language, completely ignoring the `q` quality value weights. Update pickLocale to parse quality value weights (`q=...`) from the Accept-Language header and pick the supported language with the highest weight instead of taking the first one in the list.
